visualCharacteristics.layout: Three-column grid of cards on desktop (two on tablet, one on mobile); square image above the text

contentPattern.structure: first cell: image; second cell: linked H3 title and a date paragraph

usage: Use for an 'Updates' or latest-news list of article teasers.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any article/news teaser grid. For promo tiles with text over a photo, use cards-promo-overlay.
